name: Dhamma Surabhi
aka: Vipassana Meditation Centre of British Columbia

location.address: P.O. Box 699, Merritt, BC V1K 1B8, Canada (property near Kingsvale, off the Coquihalla Highway)

tradition: Vipassana Meditation as taught by S.N. Goenka
technique: Anapana (breath awareness) followed by Vipassana body-scanning meditation, taught in silent, structured ten-day residential courses via recorded instructions and evening discourses from S.N. Goenka
teacherAccess: No individual teacher access; courses are conducted using audio and video recordings of the late S.N. Goenka's instructions and discourses, with certified assistant teachers on site to answer meditation-related questions.
retreatOptions: Ten-day residential Vipassana courses offered year-round (the centre's standard and primary offering); course dates fill 2-3 months in advance.
about: Dhamma Surabhi is the Goenka-tradition Vipassana Meditation Centre of British Columbia, set in ponderosa-pine forest in the mountains above Merritt, about 240 km northeast of Vancouver just off the Coquihalla Highway. It offers residential ten-day Vipassana courses as taught by S.N. Goenka in the tradition of Sayagyi U Ba Khin, the same technique and structure used at more than 180 Dhamma centres worldwide. Students live on site for the full course, observe Noble Silence, and follow a fixed daily meditation schedule, with simple cabins and a main building providing accommodation year-round through all four seasons. As with every centre in the Goenka network, there are no fees of any kind - courses, food and lodging are offered purely on a dana (voluntary donation) basis by past students, and the centre is run entirely by volunteers.
schedule: Standard Goenka ten-day course schedule: arrival evening begins the course, followed by ten full days of silent sitting meditation (roughly 4am-9pm) with recorded evening discourses, and departure the following morning; Noble Silence is observed by all new students for most of the course.
cost: No fees of any kind; entirely dana (voluntary donation)-based, in keeping with the worldwide Goenka Vipassana tradition - all teaching, food and accommodation are offered freely, funded by donations from past students.

pricePerDay.notes: No suggested amount; a Goenka-tradition (dhamma.org) course funded entirely by voluntary donation from past students.

foodNotes: All meals prepared and served on-site at no charge for the duration of the course; vegetarian meals included throughout.
workNotes: Old students (those who have completed at least one prior ten-day course) may serve courses or take part in maintenance work; new students are not required to work during their first course.
